messages:
Lina (Billing): Heads up: bank sent us a request for dispute evidence for ACH return on acct cust_4412. Amount USD 9,500. Reason code: R10 - Customer Advises Not Authorized. Need to assemble paper trail.
Marcus (Payments): ACH tx id ach_9922, processed via Plaid/Banking partner. Any account holder verification?
Lina (Billing): We have signed SOW and email approval from finance@clientcorp.com dated 2026-02-25. Payment originated from bank account ending 8877, routing 071000013.
Eve (Risk): R10s are tough. Was this set up as a push or pull debit?
Jules (Support): Customer support transcript shows a billing contact confirming the payment and referencing invoice INV-5533. But later on they escalated saying they didn't recognize the debit.
Marcus (Payments): Plaid linked account had micro-deposits verification passed on 2026-03-01. IP of link was 98.203.12.5 (US). Are there mismatches on who initiated refunds or who requested changes?
Lina (Billing): The invoice PDF and signed SOW attached to the tenant. I'll upload to evidence folder.
Eve (Risk): Need to include communication trail: email approval thread, invoice, signed SOW, micro-deposits verification screenshot, and IP. Also check if account name matches company name.
Marcus (Payments): Bank wants proof of authorization and that the company paid invoices. I'll prepare the ACH authorization packet.
dispute-bot: Dispute DB: case AC-22055 created 2026-03-28 status awaiting_response. Deadline 2026-04-30.
Lina (Billing): Noted. I'll also annotate the invoice with order number and PO that matches SOW.
Jules (Support): Reaching out to customer contact to confirm. Suggest offering a temporary refund hold until we verify.
Eve (Risk): If we can't produce signed authorization that explicitly references that bank account, we may lose. But looks promising with SOW + micro-deposits.
Marcus (Payments): Assembling full packet now and will upload to bank portal. Will CC Legal if any oddities.
Lina (Billing): Thanks team. We'll reconvene if bank pushes back.
